source: icc (note 91 ; confluence, étoiles, graine, bibliothèque, sections notées 4-5), exco v2 (cabinet), observatoire-des-cse (note 90), francis-gerardin (carnet de route), pierre-becq-lanterne (notée 4-5), artic.
style: Cinematic editorial photograph, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, soft volumetric light, subtle film grain, calm and contemplative, medium-format look, natural realistic colours, generous negative space.
interdits: No charts with numbers, no readable documents, no handshake, no puzzle pieces, no chess pieces, no arrows pointing up, nobody looking at the camera, no flags.
evite: Évite les métaphores usées du conseil (échecs, puzzle, flèche qui monte) : une image-idée simple (confluence, graine, carnet) et des lieux de travail vides.

404.consigne: An open notebook on an empty desk with a pencil resting on a blank page, a cup of coffee gone cold, soft lamp light, a slightly melancholic but gentle mood.

ouverture.consigne: Wide aerial view of {sujet} at dawn, two currents of different colours meeting and slowly mixing, soft mist, immense and calm, no buildings.
ouverture.evite: La salle de réunion générique en héros.

section-fond.consigne: Night sky full of fine stars above a dark, gently rolling horizon line, deep gradient, a very subtle glow on the horizon, the lower part dark and simple.

scene-metier.consigne: Top-down view of {sujet} laid out in careful order across a wooden desk, coloured index tabs, paper clips and a thin red thread linking some of the pages, methodical composition, nothing readable.
scene-metier.evite: Le texte lisible sur les dossiers.

lieu.consigne: Empty meeting room ready for a first appointment: a solid wooden table, two chairs facing each other, a closed notebook with a pencil, two glasses of water, {lumiere} falling across the table, quiet and welcoming.
lieu.source: exco (salle de premier rendez-vous), icc jim-bibliotheque
lieu.evite: Le faux bureau du cabinet (exco v2 : « aucun faux cabinet »).

texture.consigne: Macro photograph of a single seed just splitting open in dark moist soil, its first root emerging, warm side light, very shallow depth of field, dark warm background.
texture.evite: La plante mise en avant partout (exco v2 l'a retirée des secteurs).

portrait-generique.consigne: Two or three people seen from behind or in soft motion blur working at wooden desks by large windows, no face visible, morning light, calm and friendly atmosphere, candid and unposed.
portrait-generique.source: exco (bureaux en flou de bougé), observatoire-des-cse (silhouettes en contre-jour)
portrait-generique.evite: Le visage fictif « étrange » qu'exco v2 demande de relancer.
